bank.name: Punjab National Bank

history.event: Memorandum and Articles of Association filed/registered under Act VI of 1882 (Indian Companies Act); India's first Swadeshi bank
Commenced operations from Lahore with authorised capital Rs 2 lakh
New Bank of India (nationalised 1980) amalgamated into PNB
Nedungadi Bank Ltd amalgamated into PNB
Oriental Bank of Commerce and United Bank of India amalgamated into PNB

bank.notes: PNB's own 'Heritage' page states 7 (later 9, per Profile page) private-sector-bank mergers historically; earlier mergers include Bharat Bank (1951), Universal Bank of India (1961), Indo-Commercial Bank (1962) and Hindustan Commercial Bank (1986) -- included in notes only, not as separate predecessor entries, since not explicitly requested and less rigorously dated in the time available.

notes: Senior citizens (60 to <80): +50bps up to 5 years, +80bps beyond 5 years over the card rate (not printed as a number).
Retired-staff senior citizens: up to +150bps (<=5y) / +180bps (>5y) over the card rate (not printed as a number).
Super senior citizens (80+): +80bps over the card rate across all maturities (retired-staff super seniors: up to +180bps); not printed as a number beyond the *,# columns already included above.
